The Problem

PowerPoint's 30-year-old format still constrains how we persuade and decide

Twelve pain points, grouped into three themes

Fonts and layout

  • Fonts substituted on other machines
  • Text reflows when fonts are missing
  • Fixed layouts distort on projectors
  • 4:3 and 16:9 re-crop content

File size

  • Average deck is 8–15 MB
  • Hits email attachment limits
  • Large decks open slowly
  • Master slides drift off-brand

Collaboration

  • Version-control headaches
  • Binary files can't be diffed
  • Co-author merge conflicts
  • Accessibility retrofitted late
PowerPoint's legacy architecture imposes real limits on presentation quality.
